title: feat(nsxsaminc): x-axis same-lock same-tick union own-lock: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Same-tick union own lock on the x-axis same-lock seed {0,(1,0,0)} both locking +e2, y-probe frame: both bits HOLD with L(A) UNDEFINED, so the hold runs through the neighbour channel (-e3 vs +e3). Pairs with #7181 as the second same-letter-seed cell that nonetheless holds, and the note states the rule - 'opposite seed letters are not supplied here; reverse still holds from -e3 against +e3'.
